independent_tree_verifier: PASS_ALL_4; SAT models and UNSAT split trees checked; specified corruptions rejected
result: The K=4 exact one-step consequence score changed some internal branch choices but reduced the visited-state count on none of the four controls. It therefore failed to repay its additional exact planning probes on this panel.
timing_boundary: Absolute wall times are host-dependent and the full free-only replay timed out on this host. The more stable negative facts are unchanged state counts, 16-24 additional exact planning probes, additional row operations, and independently verified result trees.
research_consequence: Do not promote exact one-step component-burden lookahead as the next selector. The next selector must use a cheaper predictive feature or identify a consequential partition that the occurrence rule misses without re-solving many child states during planning.
claim_ceiling: Four-case bounded negative result about this exact K=4 planner. It is not a lower bound on lookahead, not a general heuristic ordering, and not a P-versus-NP result. No Hodge evidence is used.
